articles.title: A PLATFORM MAY ONLY REPORT WHAT IT DID
articles.content:
No surface, record, export or figure may state an outcome the platform did not produce. Where something was not
done, the record says so.
articles.content_basis: the article's own text in the canon, from its heading to its Verified line, whole
articles.verified: the three-state verdict discipline (`MET` / `UNMET` / `NOT_ASSESSABLE`, each with a basis) across `agentic_core/api/method.py` and the delivery gate; the truth sweeps in `docs/TRUTH_SWEEP_W477.md`.

articles.title: A FIGURE CARRIES ONLY THE NAME OF WHAT IT MEASURED
articles.content: A number may not be reported under the name of a quantity it did not measure.
articles.content_basis: the article's own text in the canon, from its heading to its Verified line, whole

articles.title: A VERDICT HAS THREE STATES, NEVER TWO
articles.content:
Any assessment may return not-assessable with a reason. A binary pass/fail forces a verdict where none was
reached.

articles.verified: `ValidationResult` / `ConsultationResponse` three-state work under P3.12; `assure_delivery` returns `qms_gate_passed: None` with `qms_basis` when the gate could not run.

articles.title: A SCREEN MAY FLAG AND ESCALATE; IT MAY NEVER CLEAR
articles.content: A word list, regex or heuristic may raise a concern. The absence of a match is not evidence of safety.
articles.content_basis: the article's own text in the canon, from its heading to its Verified line, whole
articles.verified: `compliance/ethical_engine.py` — every dimension returns `review` or `not_assessed`, never `pass`, and `_LEXICON_NOT_A_VERDICT` states the limit in each reason.

articles.title: AN INSTRUMENT THAT CANNOT FAIL IS NOT EVIDENCE
articles.content:
A check is admissible only if its red state is reachable. Green from an instrument that cannot go red reports
nothing.
articles.content_basis: the article's own text in the canon, from its heading to its Verified line, whole
articles.verified: the blind harness (`scripts/blind_sweep.py`) separates BLIND(red) from VACUOUS from BAD BLIND, deciding between them on pytest's exit code and classifying exit 5 — a selector that collected nothing — as BAD BLIND rather than as a pass; and every new guard is driven red before it is trusted, with the edit named, the file restored from bytes and the restore verified against a sha taken before it. Committed W537, after W536 found this line citing that path while the file had never existed — the article against unfalsifiable evidence resting on evidence nobody could run. The harness carries its own controls (`scripts/blinds_core.json`) and was measured against them before this line was restored: a known defect reported BLIND(red), the same defect under a selector matching no test reported BAD BLIND, an anchor occurring twice was refused without a run, and a log message no guard asserts reported VACUOUS. Those four are the three verdicts plus the refusal, each reached by a control rather than claimed. What the harness does NOT measure is whether a guard asserts the RIGHT property, and its coverage is the blind list and not the codebase.

articles.title: A GUARD DRIVES ITS PRECONDITION AND ITS SUBJECT
articles.content:
A check may not rely on the ambient environment, nor on whichever record a store happens to hold, to create the
condition it tests.
articles.content_basis: the article's own text in the canon, from its heading to its Verified line, whole
articles.verified: W514 corrected `test_w473`'s FU-070 leg, which chose its subject ambiently and went red against correct code when that subject became an `OWNER`-slotted row.

articles.title: PROSE IS NEVER THE MEASUREMENT
articles.content:
A check asserts a field, a binding or an AST node. Source text, comments and basis strings are not evidence,
because a comment naming a forbidden thing satisfies a search for it.

articles.title: A COUNT IS COMPUTED, NOT ASSERTED
articles.content: A quantity stated in a sentence must be derived from the state it describes.

articles.title: PROVENANCE TRAVELS WITH THE OUTPUT
articles.content:
Whatever produced a result is recorded where a reader meets the result — in the file, the export, the download
and the card, not only in the DOM.

articles.content: A missing value is stored as a stated absence with a reason, never omitted and never defaulted.
